answer: Each agent identity is registered in the basalt state tree only after a TPM/SGX enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation of a unique measured runtime; wharf, a consensus contract, verifies the proof and locks a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), while plume records hash-linked attestations. Forging identities requires physically provisioning distinct silicon and defeating enclave measurements; invalid proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
